title: ResultEnvelope
description: The V0 stage result envelope the runner acts on; consumed by gates and telemetry (ARCHITECTURE.md §5). Bulk outputs are artifact pointers; outputs carries scalars only.

status.description: Terminal business outcome reported by the stage.

outputs.description: Small declared scalar values only. Anything larger is an artifact, referenced by pointer — state does not travel through outputs.

artifacts.description: Content-addressed artifacts produced by the stage.

transcript.description: Runner-captured transcript for this agentic attempt. Diagnostic only; unlike artifacts, it is not passed to downstream stages.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the stage result.

metrics.description: Numeric metrics emitted by the stage.

error.description: Structured failure detail for failure results.

integrity.description: Provenance of the content this stage produced: the weakest grade among the inputs it was admitted with. Downstream stages resolving inputsFrom grade against this, because outputs are bare scalars that carry no label of their own.

workspaceRevision.description: Optional immutable repository and exact-object authority. It is established only by a successful deterministic result and is absent for legacy workflows.

allOf.comment: A failure result must carry error detail.

causes.description: Ordered structured cause chain when the producer can preserve wrapped-error boundaries; absent for legacy or unavailable structure.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the stage failure may succeed.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for this cause layer, when available.

class.description: Stable classification for this cause layer, when available.

message.description: Human-readable message for this cause layer.
